name: mime
doc:
MIME types (Go's mime package): extension <-> type lookup (built-in
table in runtime/src/std_mime.c, extendable at run time), media type
parsing and formatting with RFC 2231 parameter continuations and
charsets, and RFC 2047 encoded words in headers. Multipart bodies are
mime.multipart, quoted-printable mime.quotedprintable.

items.name: AddExtensionType
items.signature: func AddExtensionType(ext string, typ string) void!
items.doc: Associates ext (with its leading dot) with a media type.
items.summary: Associates ext (with its leading dot) with a media type.

items.name: DecodeHeader
items.doc:
Decodes the encoded words of a header value (Q and B encodings,
charsets utf-8, us-ascii, iso-8859-1); white space between adjacent
encoded words is dropped. Unknown charsets are an error.
items.summary: Decodes the encoded words of a header value (Q and B encodings, charsets utf-8, us-ascii, iso-8859-1); white space between adjacent encoded words is dropped.

items.name: EncodeWord
items.doc:
Encodes s as one Q-encoded word ("=?utf-8?q?...?=") when it is not
printable ASCII, else returns it unchanged.
items.summary: Encodes s as one Q-encoded word ("=?utf-8?q?...?=") when it is not printable ASCII, else returns it unchanged.

items.name: ExtensionsByType
items.doc: The extensions known for a media type (parameters ignored), sorted.
items.summary: The extensions known for a media type (parameters ignored), sorted.

items.name: FormatMediaType
items.signature: func FormatMediaType(typ string, params map[string]string) string
items.doc:
"type/subtype; k=v" with keys sorted, values quoted when needed and
non-ASCII values in RFC 2231 form (k*=utf-8''...); "" if typ is invalid.
items.summary: "type/subtype; k=v" with keys sorted, values quoted when needed and non-ASCII values in RFC 2231 form (k*=utf-8''...); "" if typ is invalid.

items.name: ParseMediaType
items.doc:
Parses "type/subtype; key=value; ..." (also a Content-Disposition
value like "attachment; filename=a.txt").
items.summary: Parses "type/subtype; key=value; ..." (also a Content-Disposition value like "attachment; filename=a.txt").

items.name: TypeByExtension
items.doc:
The media type for a file extension (".html" -> "text/html;
charset=utf-8"); "" if unknown. The lookup is case-insensitive.
items.summary: The media type for a file extension (".html" -> "text/html; charset=utf-8"); "" if unknown.

items.name: MediaType
items.doc: A parsed media type: Type is lower case ("text/html"), Params keys too.
items.summary: A parsed media type: Type is lower case ("text/html"), Params keys too.
